Container.Name: photon
Container.DonateText: If you find my own projects useful, you're welcome to buy me a coffee. If I'm only providing an Unraid template for someone else's project, please consider donating to the original developer instead.
Container.Overview:
Photon is an open-source geocoding solution built for OpenStreetMap (OSM) data, providing features such as search-as-you-type and reverse geocoding.
This CA uses rtuszik's unofficial Docker image (see Project) for running Photon locally, enhancing data privacy and integration capabilities with services like Dawarich⁠.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: OSM geocoder reverse geocoding address address lookup place location dawarich
Container.Changes:
### 2026-11-09
- Add selectable regions, update strategies, and logging levels. - Add configurable download retries, checksum verification, and disk space checks. - Add support for custom index URLs, JVM parameters, and Photon startup options. - Add optional Apprise notifications and Prometheus metrics. - Update environment variable descriptions and defaults. - Update documentation links, icon, and WebUI.
### 2025-09-25
Initial release

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Example usage: http://[IP]:[PORT]/api?q=Berlin

Config.Name: Update Strategy
Config.Description: Controls how index updates are handled. PARALLEL downloads the new index in the background then swaps with minimal downtime (requires 2x space). SEQUENTIAL stops Photon, deletes the existing index, downloads the new one, then restarts. DISABLED prevents automatic updates.

Config.Name: Update Interval
Config.Description: Minimum age of the local index before checking for a newer version. After that age is reached, the mirror is checked at most hourly until an update is available. Example: 30d or 720h.

Config.Name: Region
Config.Description:
LARGE FILE SIZES! This might take up to 200GB depending on the selected region!
Optional region for a specific dataset. Can be a continent (europe, asia), individual country/region (germany, usa, japan), country code (de, us, jp), or planet for worldwide data. See: https://github.com/rtuszik/photon-docker#available-regions

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Controls logging verbosity. (DEBUG, INFO, ERROR)

Config.Name: Photon Listen IP
Config.Description: IP address that the Photon HTTP server listens on; 0.0.0.0 listens on all container interfaces.

Config.Name: Force Update
Config.Description: Forces an index update on container startup, regardless of UPDATE_STRATEGY. (TRUE, FALSE)

Config.Name: Download Max Retries
Config.Description: Maximum number of retries after failed index downloads.

Config.Name: Checksum Max Retries
Config.Description: Maximum retries after an index download fails MD5 verification. Ignored if SKIP_MD5_CHECK is TRUE.

Config.Name: Initial Download
Config.Description: Download the initial prebuilt index when the Photon data directory is empty. Set to FALSE for a manual import.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL for downloading prebuilt index files; must point to the index archive directory. This configured GraphHopper URL overrides the upstream community-mirror default.

Config.Name: Skip MD5 Check
Config.Description: Optionally skip MD5 verification of downloaded index files. (TRUE, FALSE)

Config.Name: Skip Space Check
Config.Description: Skip the available-disk-space check before downloading an index. Normally leave FALSE.

Config.Name: File Url
Config.Description: Optional direct URL to a prebuilt .tar.bz2 index. When set, automatic updates are disabled; checksum verification is skipped unless MD5_URL is provided.

Config.Name: MD5 URL
Config.Description: Optional URL for the MD5 checksum file associated with FILE_URL. Leave empty when no custom checksum URL is needed.

Config.Name: Photon Params
Config.Description: Optional extra arguments passed to the Photon executable. See https://github.com/komoot/photon#running-photon

Config.Name: Java Params
Config.Description: Optional extra JVM parameters passed to Java when launching Photon (e.g. -Xmx4g). Leave empty for no additional parameters.

Config.Name: Apprise Urls
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated Apprise notification URLs for downloads, updates and errors (e.g. pover://user@token). See https://github.com/caronc/apprise

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID under which Photon runs. Set to the host user ID with write access to the bind-mounted data directory.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID under which Photon runs. Set to the host group ID with write access to the bind-mounted data directory.

Config.Name: Enable Metrics
Config.Description: Enable the Prometheus metrics endpoint at /metrics. (TRUE, FALSE)
